meta.title: Rostel Panoumassi · Digital product engineering
meta.description: I design and ship SaaS, payment and management platforms, from architecture to production. Six years of experience, three as tech lead. Cotonou, Benin.

hero.ledeRest: , product engineer and Head of Engineering at KPS Groupe. Six years of experience, three as tech lead. Ubbfy, ContractIQ, ZenLife: products shipped, not mockups.

positioning.title: I don’t just ship code. I ship products that hold up.
positioning.visionText: Understand the business, the users and the constraints before writing a line.
positioning.architectureText: Choose the foundations: data, payments, security, scale.
positioning.executionText: Build, test, ship to production and keep improving with the team.

work.title: Three products, from architecture to launch.

ubbfy.challenge: Rebuild a complete ERP around a single API serving three clients: web, PWA and a Flutter app.
ubbfy.alt: Ubbfy, home page and candidate pipeline preview

contractiq.challenge: Extract parties, deadlines and risky clauses from PDF contracts, then alert before every renewal. Gemini as the main engine, OpenAI as fallback.
contractiq.alt: ContractIQ, AI risk analysis of a contract

zenlife.challenge: Planning, budget, messaging and reminders in a single app, used by 1,200+ active users within six months.

method.title: From idea to production, without losing the thread.
method.discoverText: Understand the problem, the users, the goals and the constraints.
method.designText: Define the experience, the architecture, the features and the technical choices.
method.buildText: Develop, test, gather feedback and improve the product.
method.evolveText: Prepare maintenance, performance and new features.

conversion.title: Let’s talk about your project.
conversion.text: A platform to design, a product to take over or a team to structure: describe your needs in a few minutes, I reply within 48 hours.
